newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 10.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
New South Wales supreme court judge Kim Santow on Thursday approved the scheme of arrangement to merge Advance Bank and St George. The ruling was made after the market had closed.

Property group expands its growing UK presence with through the purchase of a 25 percent stake in property developer THI Plc, which has a development programme in excess of 200 million stg over the next three years.

The Australian Financial Review reports that conglomerate is set to face a fresh round of claims from Australian users of the heart pacemakers and leads from its former unit Telectronics Pacing Systems.

U.S. broker Raymond James Financial recommends a buy recommendation for the Australian oil producer. Petroleum Securities announced on Thursday it had a new oil discovery in the Gulf of Mexico and also increased oil production.
Kidston announces after Thursday's market close that it expects to report a decline of over 15 percent in operating profist for calendar 1996.
